name: Singtel-UOB Card
highlights: 10% Cashback on Local Online & Mobile Contactless spend
0% FX Fees on Foreign Currency Spend
12% cashback on Singtel/GOMO Spend (Including handset purchase!)
0% FX fees on Foreign Currency Spend (no min. spend, no cap)
10% cashback on Local Online and Mobile Contactless (Apple Pay, Google Pay) spend
Waiver of Annual Fee with 12-month recurring Singtel and/or GOMO bills
Enjoy up to S$300 Singtel vouchers per year when you spend S$12,000/yr locally on the card
Free Taste of Red Access for 6 months
Free 6-months of CAST packs for all Singtel-UOB Cardmembers
Extra 10GB local data and 100 mins talktime monthly when you sign up or recontract to an eligible Singtel mobile plan
Free 12-months of CAST packs when you sign up or recontract to an eligible Singtel broadband plan

Enjoy one-time waivers of the SIM card fee (worth $21.80), registration fee (worth $10.90) and recontract fee (worth $10.90) upon sign-up or recontract of an eligible mobile plan + waiver of the NetLink Trust service activation charge (worth $61.04 per port) when you sign up for a new fibre broadband

our_takes.our-take: The Singtel-UOB Card is best viewed as a lifestyle cashback card optimised for Singtel subscribers and digital spending habits, rather than a general-purpose cashback card. Its strongest value comes from recurring telco bills, online purchases, mobile contactless payments, and overseas spend, especially for users who can consistently meet the S$800 monthly qualifying spend.
our_takes.good-for:
Singtel or GOMO users paying recurring telco bills
Online shoppers and mobile contactless spenders
Travellers who want to avoid foreign transaction fees
Cardholders with consistent monthly spending patterns
our_takes.things-to-note:
You need S$800 monthly spend to unlock 10–12% cashback; otherwise most spend earns 0.3%
Cashback is capped monthly, so higher spend won’t increase rewards beyond limits
Annual fee is waived only with 12 consecutive months of recurring Singtel/GOMO billing
“No FX fees” still means exchange rate spreads apply on overseas spend
Cashback posts later and may be forfeited if the card is cancelled
